description: Retrieve confirmed customer adoption changes for a specified vendor within a UTC time window, returning customer domains with `ADDED` or `REMOVED` events, supporting evidence, and timestamps. `ADDED` represents a confirmed `ABSENT -> PRESENT` transition and `REMOVED` represents a confirmed `PRESENT -> ABSENT` transition in STRAELO CSI observations; `REMOVED` does not by itself prove a vendor switch or contract cancellation. USE WHEN: an agent needs historical evidence of customers adopting or removing a specific vendor during a period. DO NOT USE WHEN: the agent needs customers currently confirmed as using a vendor (`vendor_customer_confirmed_lookup`), vendors currently detected on a specific customer domain (`customer_vendor_detection`), or potential vendor replacement signals. Parameter semantics: `vendor` identifies the vendor whose history is queried and supports the current canonical vendor names and aliases; `start` is inclusive and `end` is exclusive, both must be timezone-aware and `end` must be later than `start`; `limit` optionally limits results from 1 to 100 and defaults to 100. Results are ordered by most recent change first, then customer domain.

vendor.description: Technology/vendor to query confirmed changes for (e.g., klaviyo, yotpo, judge.me).
vendor.title: Vendor

name: vendor_customer_adoption_change_lookup

change_count.description: Total confirmed changes for the vendor in the window.

changes.description: Confirmed ADDED/REMOVED changes ordered by changed_at DESC, domain ASC.

changed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the durable transition was observed.

domain.description: Customer domain that experienced a confirmed technology change.

fingerprints.description: Bounded matched fingerprint evidence (ids and types only).

from_state.description: State before the transition (ABSENT or PRESENT).

response_validity.description: Response validity of the confirming observation.

scanner_version.description: Scanner version that produced the observation.

to_state.description: State after the transition (PRESENT or ABSENT).

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the query response generation.

title: Vendor Customer Adoption Change Lookup
